title: Configuration
body: `docc.json` is optional and every field has a default. The nearest `docc.json` is used: it is looked up in the current folder, then in the parent folders, and its folder becomes the project root, so docc can run from a subfolder. If there is none, the current folder is the root and the defaults apply; `docc init` does not look upward. Unknown keys are errors, reported as docc.json:line:column: config error: message with exit code 2. `docc schema config` prints the full schema.

Paths: `src`, `out`, `schemas` and `outFull`. The folder `out` is owned by docc: the build deletes every file in it that no source produced. Folders that overlap the sources, the schemas or the project root are refused.

`roots` lists the ids from which reachability is counted, default `index`. `tags` is an optional registry of allowed tags, checked by DOC107. Kinds have no registry: a kind exists when its schema file exists in the schemas folder.

`rules` maps a code, a rule name or a group name to a level or to an object with a level and the parameters `words` and `allow` of the word rules. A rule is more specific than its group, and a group is more specific than the preset. `recommended` set to `false` turns the preset off; core rules stay on. `maxWarnings` sets the warning limit of every command. `changesSince` names the Git revision (a tag, branch or commit) of the version the reader of the HTML file last received: the file shows the changes since it by default and keeps no history before it.
`customRules` define rules as a regular expression over a JSON pointer: forbid a match or require one.
`numbering` set to `true` makes docc number the pages and their sections, as described in [[rendering]]. `lang` is `en` (the default) or `ru` and sets the language of the fixed labels of the pages.

`branding` (name, url, logo, accent, accentLight, header) dresses the single HTML file for a company, as described in [[rendering]]; `name` is required, the logo is a file inside the project and must exist.
`trace.scan` lists masks of code files, from the project root, that are searched for `docc:` tags; without it DOC401, DOC402 and DOC403 do not run.
